sources.entry: Fanny - Monitor your Mac's fan speed and CPU temperature from your Notification Center.

summary.one_liner: Fanny is a macOS app that shows your Mac's fan speed and CPU/GPU temperature in Notification Center.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes Fanny as a tool for monitoring a Mac's fan speed and CPU/GPU temperature from Notification Center. It references SMC (the System Management Controller), which is the likely source of those sensor readings. The README is very short and does not describe build steps, configuration, or a feature list. The download link is referenced but the URL is missing from the text. The repository is listed under the System category of a macOS apps collection.
use_cases: view GPU temperature on a Mac
see sensor readings in Notification Center
notable: Shows fan speed and CPU/GPU temperature in Notification Center
Uses SMC as its sensor reference
caveats: README is minimal; no build or install instructions are given
The download location is referenced but not linked in the README
macOS only, as implied by Notification Center and Mac focus
